Specification: This module defines a very small TLA+ specification used to evaluate a set-theoretic expression involving subsets of {1,2,3}, a maximum-element helper, and a conditional test that compares an element x with Max(s). The comments indicate it is attempting to check equality of the integer 1 with a non-integer set expression, so the file is primarily about expression evaluation and type behavior rather than a distributed algorithm or protocol. It defines trivial Init and Next operators, where both are unsatisfiable because they are conjoined with FALSE, and includes an ASSUME using TLC's PrintT to display a tuple containing a diagnostic string and the value of sillyExpr.
IfThenElse: IF x = Max(s) THEN TRUE ELSE (x+1) \in s
